scope: Nineteen assigned canonical primary/developmental units. Later November 4-9 scientific-use units are audited separately by the team.
method: Read frozen narratives and stored aggregate JSON. Only descriptive arithmetic on stored discrepancies was derived. No generation, raw patient/generated-table inspection, patient-reference recomputation, web/source search or historical artifact edit.
grade_note: Labels denote inference regime, not ordinal quality; prospective results may be negative.

baseline_fairness_audit.E0_input: CHNS: sanitized source populations/selection/measurement, fifteen grouped marginal records and unit guidance, zero relationship records/compiled relational items, no full paper/broad summary, no disclosed correlation coefficient/direction. ENSANUT: seventeen records of Lifelines margins, duplicate converted representations and unit guidance. Broad historical summaries were excluded because they contained relationships. Intended analyses visible in both arms.
baseline_fairness_audit.author_completion: Authors choose and explicitly declare unreported dependence, residual distributions and target transport. Unsupported cross-covariances are not zero facts. Existing model knowledge is not erased, and pretraining nonexposure is not established. No new retrieval, repository search, source IPD or numerical target access allowed.
baseline_fairness_audit.statistical_E0: Fixed positive Gaussian copula source-moment family minimizes -log(det R). With no relational constraints, source components are independent. CHNS is an equal Jansen/Bao/MIND donor mixture, which may induce between-component dependence, with requested uniform ages and donor-specific female fraction. ENSANUT is a Jansen donor under exact target age/sex cells. Near-zero focal effects follow a particular missing-dependence completion; they are not a limitation of statistical synthesis as a class.
baseline_fairness_audit.statistical_E1: CHNS constrains both separate Jansen projections, Bao Pearson and MIND Spearman in separate qualified source contexts. ENSANUT constrains two Jansen projections; Pani age slope and eight age bands remain context-only for missing-source-law reasons. All ENSANUT E1 Agents instead constrain Pani age slope. That uptake difference is concrete but not experimentally isolated as the cause of the age advantage.
baseline_fairness_audit.budget: Same available empirical packets and final three-seed schedule. Agent authors allowed at most two exploratory attempts and optional decision; the fixed statistical recipe used one deterministic source fit from an all-zero dependence start, 300-iteration cap, no alternate-family/start search and no exploratory row draw. Five independent Agent models versus one specification. Equal data access is not equal scientific search/design/feedback effort.
baseline_fairness_audit.interpretation: E0 six-of-six is a comparison of selected Agent joint-law completions with an entropy/independence completion. The evidence supports flexibility under incomplete specification as a candidate explanation; neither pretrained biomedical knowledge nor evidence integration is causally identified. The paper's strongest claim should not rest on this restrictive baseline alone.

units.input_setting: Complete cohorts without individual inputs. Two researcher-exposed references. E0 has source marginal/basic measurement evidence; E1 adds qualified relationships. Target statistics withheld from authors.
units.comparison: Five independently authored laws versus one fixed statistical specification per case/condition, three seeds each. Available empirical input matched within condition, numerical uptake and model-design effort not matched.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Strongest direct biomedical comparative result: added relational evidence lowers discrepancy in five of six prespecified regressions. Agent arm mean is closer than the delivered fixed statistical reference in six of six E0 and four of six E1 comparisons. These are real favorable regions, with important baseline and exposure limits.

numeric_support.aggregation: Mean absolute discrepancy over three seeds within constructor, then equal mean over five Agent constructors. Units are not pooled.

counterresults: CHNS BMI discrepancy increases 54.85% with E1; all E1 constructor means remain below reference.
E1 statistical CHNS glucose and ENSANUT conditional BMI are closer than every corresponding Agent construction.
Every ENSANUT E1 age seed exceeds reference-band upper bound; BMI constructor means remain below reference-band lower bounds. CHNS E1 A03 retains a negative conditional-age mean.
Seven authors use exploratory feedback and retain; thirteen finalize initially; zero scientific revisions.

E0 statistical entropy completion gives independence within source components. CHNS donor mixing can induce between-source dependence; ENSANUT uses a single Jansen donor. The E0 six-of-six contrast is against this restrictive completion, not all statistical synthesis.

ENSANUT E1 Agents numerically constrain the Pani age projection; statistical reference leaves it and eight age bands contextual because source dispersion/age law/weighting are unbound. This permits an evidence-use flexibility hypothesis, not causal attribution or family superiority.
units.inference_scope: Descriptive development on two exposed target families. Source overlap, pretrained knowledge, assumed completion and transport remain. Fresh authors/seeds are not new clinical replications.
units.paper_role: Main empirical comparison. Focus on analysis-specific benefit of applicable relationship evidence; preserve every endpoint and comparator.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Distinct authoring experiment, but reuses existing CHNS/ENSANUT reference samples.

units.input_setting: L uses external literature and requested analyses. R additionally receives complete CHNS reference summaries and metadata, including all thirty evaluated summaries.
units.comparison: Three fresh authors per information arm; initial versus retained final stages. Initial delivery already allowed trial feedback; this is not feedback versus no feedback.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Complete reference summaries substantially improve supplied-summary reconstruction: 27 of thirty arm-average discrepancies lower, three binary-quantile ties, none higher.
counterresults: All evaluated reference summaries are inputs to R; this is reconstruction, not hidden-outcome discovery.
All six final laws retained initial versions; no revision gain. Initial/final delivery duplicates are not extra draws.
Source replay unavailable; three seeds measure conditional sampling only.
units.inference_scope: One exposed developmental sample, three authors per condition. Strong reconstruction contrast, not target transport or unique-Agent advantage.
units.paper_role: Positive information-sufficiency boundary; pair with conventional summary comparator.
units.duplication_and_lineage: R01-R03 nine unique delivery tables are reused by summary_comparator and must not count again as new Agent data.

units.input_setting: New fixed statistical calibrator receives the complete empirical packet previously allowed to R01-R03, including thirty target summaries, intervals/design metadata and original external audit.
units.comparison: One new fixed statistical law versus three historical Agent laws. Empirical inputs matched; feedback/search/model-selection budgets and temporal knowledge unmatched. Statistical family designed with coding-Agent assistance.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Conventional calibration also achieves close primary coefficients; supplied-summary consistency is shared capability, with mixed endpoint ordering.
counterresults: Statistical glucose and Pearson discrepancies are lower; Agent mean BMI, age and Spearman are lower.
All thirty summaries supplied; no unseen-analysis gain.
Three original path-format errors were prelaunch orchestration failures; no three failed sampled tables.
Same-input audit does not make this equal-budget prospective comparison or establish end-to-end effort savings.
units.inference_scope: Reconstruction supplement, not independent clinical validation or general method-family superiority.
units.paper_role: Essential comparator boundary; report shared reconstruction success, not exclusive Agent capability.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Only three statistical tables are new; all historical R01-R03 outputs come from information_revision_ablation.

units.input_setting: Original HRS published aggregate exports and method code; own Agent recursive implementation versus reconstruction of published recipient-stage law. No participant inputs.
units.comparison: Two implementations of essentially the same rich published family; common native R/lme4 evaluation. Three draws each versus original paper's 5,000-draw average.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Whole longitudinal synthetic cohorts with conditional covariates, nonlinear HbA1c, interactions and correlated subject random effects support the published mixed-model analysis.
counterresults: Our CRLF parser overwrote seven HbA1c coefficient/SE pairs; original three comparator tables invalid. This is our implementation failure, not evidence against published method. Recovery changed only seven pairs/locators; generator bytes and Agent outputs unchanged.

Agent above-threshold magnitude too high; one Wald interval excludes zero although source interval includes zero. Corrected comparator point signs negative, intervals include zero; three draws and different random-effect sampling do not rank accuracy.
Upper HbA1c spread follows published synthetic law but severely understates original cohort spread.
Independent GLS checks coefficients/SEs conditional on fitted variances, not independent REML optimization.
units.inference_scope: Source-rich reconstruction and longitudinal capability. Coefficients are supplied inputs; no unseen relationship discovery, new simulation family, transport or superiority.
units.paper_role: Breadth/capability example; do not make it an accuracy win.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Technical recovery is part of same experiment. Corrected six valid tables define comparison; invalid initial comparator results excluded from scientific ranking.

units.input_setting: One fresh author receives full exposed CHNS reference/evidence package and revises dependence after analytic/trial feedback.
units.comparison: Paired initial/final draws from one law; targeted dependence change while maintaining analytic covariance target; no separate control author.
units.strongest_supported_finding: An actual targeted revision reduces rank-correlation discrepancy on all three paired draws, with explicit regression trade-offs.
counterresults: All three primary regression MADs increase slightly; glucose discrepancy worsens on every paired seed.
First dependence adjustment did not show rank improvement under different trial seeds.
One author and full target summaries do not isolate causal feedback effect or global quality gain.
units.paper_role: Small concrete repair case, not generally effective revision policy.

units.input_setting: Two previously authored literature-guided laws reused after metadata-only alias/conversion correction; self-review and source-feedback branch decisions.
units.comparison: Two assumed laws and their retained branches; no new statistical or matched old/new method comparator.
units.strongest_supported_finding: A02 reproduces the adjusted CHNS glucose slope reasonably across three seeds while multiple other uses fail.
counterresults: BMI too small, age unsupported/unrecovered; narrower glucose and HbA1c spread and different joint correlations coexist with slope agreement.
All four branch authors retain; every paired endpoint contrast zero.
Qualified source point checks are not strict replay because weights/processing unknown.
units.inference_scope: Two reused laws and one exposed target; selected-use feasibility only.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Pilot laws reused; 72 executions yield 24 distinct hashes and zero new initial scientific constructors.

units.input_setting: Two new source/target laws planned for source-feedback/self-review comparison.
units.comparison: No comparison ran: native HbA1c alias admission failed after permitted technical returns.
units.strongest_supported_finding: No empirical data-quality finding; two authored laws and shared interface failure retained.
counterresults: Static finite-moment/nondegeneracy review is not finite execution or target utility.
One semantic approval was revoked after actual validator reproduced failure.
units.inference_scope: Closed before generation; no comparative scientific result.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Same two laws later executed in developmental_continuation; do not count planned allocations as data.

units.input_setting: Exposed CHNS, no individual inputs or numerical target to authors. E0 source marginals; E1 same plus four relationships.
units.comparison: Fresh author contexts under E0/E1, three draws each; extra relationships mostly qualitative rather than numerical constraints.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Large selected glucose-analysis gain, but prespecified overall improvement condition fails.
counterresults: BMI MAD rises 10.7%, age 19.8%; both addressed projections had to improve, so fixed condition false.
Seven laws exponentiate positive raw unbounded lognormal BMI, yielding divergent required population moments. Finite-table regressions ran; all seven retained in denominator.
E1 HbA1c SD 0.561-0.861 versus .954; Spearman .499-.585 versus .361.
No E1 model numerically enforced either Jansen projection.
units.inference_scope: Historical partial development benefit; no joint-fidelity or valid-law guarantee.
units.paper_role: Historical benefit plus rationale for explicit numerical-use/moment checks.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Distinct authorship experiment on same later-reused CHNS sample; not new clinical replication.

units.input_setting: Qualified source relationship interpretations plus one Japanese health-check target access attempt.
units.comparison: No clinical comparison: DOI not found, no target participant file.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Source-statistic semantics prepared and access failure documented; no efficacy finding.
counterresults: Failure of inspected access routes is not scientific method rejection or proof all routes fail.

units.input_setting: Invented exact moments. Four packets: none, marginal/pairwise, plus conditional, minus conditional. Group composition .5 to .75; conditional transport stipulated.
units.comparison: Same task/interface, one fresh author per packet. Known artificial worlds fixed before construction; evidence contrast confounded with author variation.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Conditional evidence yields correct opposite target directions and lower error than marginal packet on every planned seed.
counterresults: Marginal B is farther from minus-world truth than no-evidence A.
Conditional target coefficient algebraically identified under stipulated transfer; translation, not discovery.
Normal and standardized t3 residuals preserve all moments but imply different tails; unreported tail use unidentified.
One author per packet and no same-information statistical comparator prohibit general superiority or causal mechanism attribution.
units.paper_role: Compact mechanism support, not novel statistical theory.

units.input_setting: Implementation of explicit evidence-use, declared context laws, qualified source operators and source-only control.
units.comparison: Software verification on invented fixtures, no clinical data comparison.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Checks catch specific missing bindings, invalid source operators and divergent required moments in supported grammar.
counterresults: Static grammar checks do not certify arbitrary Python or biomedical transfer.
No source-fit/target/revision gain produced.

units.input_setting: One fresh author uses admitted E1 literature packet and separate source contexts; no target generation.
units.comparison: Input source statistics compared with one draw per source; Agent receives full feedback and retains.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Numerical evidence reaches generated source statistics, independently verified.
counterresults: These source statistics were construction inputs; not hidden target successes.
Strict source replay unavailable due original weighting/processing uncertainty.
Extreme converted IFCC lower support, glucose clipping point mass and age/sex independence remain limitations.
One retained decision; zero revision improvement.
units.inference_scope: Qualified source-only numerical uptake, no target transport.

units.input_setting: Evidence-only complete cohorts. HAALSI prospectively admitted; Turkana investigator-context-exposed prospective quantitative holdout.
units.comparison: Five authors plus one prescribed statistical construction per case, three target seeds. Frozen all-endpoint/all-seed resolution .10 and at least four of five authors required; zero-anchor check predeclared.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Coarse directions transfer in several analyses, but broad reliability/expansion claim fails prospectively.
counterresults: Primary reliability fails both cases; HAALSI resolution also admits three zero relationships, so passing does not establish nonzero joint recovery.
HAALSI statistical maximum .1045 is just over .10: highlighting Agent passes versus statistical fail overstates superiority.
Turkana TC slope 10.2822-15.0413 versus reference point 5.6831; residual r .1162-.5361 versus .5121.
All ten authors retain; no changed-final/revision gain. Higher tolerance sensitivity cannot rescue frozen result.
units.inference_scope: Prospective quantitative evaluation with case-specific exposure qualification. Directional feasibility weaker than reliable analytical recovery.
units.paper_role: Essential external evaluation and limit on any broad paper promise.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Initial/final slots alias the same 36 target tables; later Turkana interfaces reuse measured reference and are not fresh clinical confirmation.

units.input_setting: Official metadata/access/measurement review before terms consent and F2 release.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Measurement/selection/exposure boundaries clarified before later F2.
counterresults: Historical consent checkpoint is not a current project obstruction; F2 later completed.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Admission and F2 are stages of one target family; only F2 contributes generation/evaluation.

units.input_setting: External-evidence whole cohort; analyses fixed before this evaluation, historical CHNS exposure documented. No patient input or numerical target supplied to authors.
units.comparison: Two Agent-selected structures with same evidence; exact retained initial/final stages, no statistical comparator.
units.strongest_supported_finding: All eighteen coefficients in six distinct tables have reference-positive directions; C2 glucose near reference, other uses weaker.
counterresults: BMI only 30-39% of reference magnitude. C2 improves glucose versus C1 but worsens age.
Similar means conceal narrow SDs; task-population source proxies are not true source replay.
Both retain; final outputs byte-identical. Historical exposure and source-supported directions restrict untouched-confirmation wording.
units.inference_scope: Limited directional/selected magnitude feasibility, no superiority or general target fidelity.
units.paper_role: Historical biomedical feasibility and first evidence-gap diagnosis.
units.duplication_and_lineage: One CHNS sample subsequently reused. Twelve slots are six unique tables.

units.input_setting: Invented three-stratum source means/SDs, Agent Gamma completion, no individual input.
units.comparison: Initial versus same-seed retained generator; source checks only.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Whole-cohort authoring, authenticated feedback and retention path executed correctly.
counterresults: One unique fictional draw, no target or revision benefit.
Gamma tails/independence not identified by moments.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Two physical executions are the same table, not independent cohorts.

units.input_setting: One author specifies two structures from heterogeneous 32-item source packet and twenty checks; no target.
units.comparison: Bounded deterministic scalar fit at one seed, baseline/selected replay at two unused seeds. Agent defines laws/criteria; optimizer changes scalars.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Linear source loss falls on both unused seeds, but full compatibility remains incomplete. Alternative fit loses baseline compatibility.
counterresults: Linear misses older-age mean twice and age slope just below lower threshold once.
Alternative selected fit worsens both unused losses and introduces age-slope failures although baseline passes all checks.
Full structural-preference rule fails; no target selected. Scalar optimization is not new Agent scientific feedback revision.
units.inference_scope: Source-only development under assumed source populations and engineering thresholds, no clinical/transport validation.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Seventy-four trials and 164 source executions are fitting work, not clinical replications.

units.input_setting: Artificial complete-covariance task A and partial-moment task B; two compatible B worlds fixed before authorship.
units.comparison: Retain, minimum source loss and protected-use policies all select c0; every label identical per seed. Same B tables scored under both worlds.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Identification counterexample: incomplete source moments cannot determine adjusted relationship sign; complete covariance supports intended linear projection.
counterresults: Policy comparison nondiscriminating: no selector benefit.
Artificial covariance identity is not a biological discovery or new statistical result.
Compatible worlds are witnesses without probabilities, not a full identified set.
units.inference_scope: Artificial identification illustration and negative policy finding.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Twenty-four test slots reduce to six unique tables; 108 endpoint rows and 81 policy rows are evaluation reuse.

units.input_setting: Artificial fully identified Gaussian law; same final evidence for full generation and parent-preserving extension, parent input synthetic.
units.comparison: Three seeds per route; one specified law represented as parent/joint/conditional extension. Four request decisions individually reviewed.
units.strongest_supported_finding: Conditional extension preserves every old cell and existing analysis while adding residual variation and enabling new adjusted analyses.
counterresults: Exact Gaussian moments identify answers; no unknown biological relationship recovery.
Extension maximum variance deviation +2.1265 and x1-slope absolute deviation .1006 retained.
No route accuracy superiority, feedback revision or biomedical transport tested.
units.paper_role: Appendix capability example, not main biomedical benefit.
units.duplication_and_lineage: Three parent tables plus six final three-variable tables; nine runs are not nine independent cohorts.

cross_unit_limits: Repeated clinical references and overlapping source evidence are not independent biological replication.
Independent audits, public-export copies, figures and rerendered tables do not create experiments.
Summary-comparator Agent outputs are reused from information-revision; continuation reuses pilot laws; HRS recovery corrects the same comparison; initial/final aliases count once.
No assigned unit establishes broad Agent-over-statistics superiority, general feedback effectiveness, arbitrary-analysis validity, clinical interchangeability or calibrated transport uncertainty.

candidate_strengths.claim: Five of six information contrasts improve; four of six E1 Agent averages beat the delivered fixed statistical reference, with two statistical wins retained.
candidate_strengths.limit: Exposed development references; uptake/model-design asymmetry, no general superiority.

candidate_strengths.theme: Strong reconstruction when sufficient summaries are supplied
candidate_strengths.claim: Complete CHNS summaries improve twenty-seven metrics and tie three; a rich longitudinal law is reconstructible.
candidate_strengths.limit: Targets/coefficients supplied, conventional calibration shares capability, original-data mismatch remains.

candidate_strengths.theme: Specific conditional-evidence use and targeted repair
candidate_strengths.claim: Rank discrepancy repair and artificial conditional sign transfer are demonstrated.
candidate_strengths.limit: Repair trades off every primary regression; one constructor per condition, exposed/artificial settings, no general revision gain.
